1.bug_scenario: In the Nav component, when using the 'iconOnly' mode, items that do not have an icon configured are still rendered, resulting in empty or blank spaces in the navigation bar. The image shows a vertical navigation bar where some items are just empty spaces (no icon or text), which is not the expected behavior. Ideally, items without icons should not be rendered or should have a fallback to avoid blank entries.
